detail.longDescription: I was struggling with getting this working as there's no official support for reporting battery life via bluetooth and via cable. It took a bit of trial and error - but there's a working menu bar item, a control center command, works with the desktop widget (where you'd see airpods, mouse etc), and you can control lighting with it! Hopefully it helps someone :) A lot of credit goes to claude code and Keychron for having open source firmware. This was tested with K10 Pro.
